dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visibility of thin, sharp, light-grey borders along the margins of the folded primaries, creating strong contrast with the dark grey interior feather regions.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and non-linear transition; the pale grayscale values of the crown merge gradually into the darker, patterned feathers of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'scalloped' patterning across the dorsal surface caused by broad, light-colored fringes on dark-centered feathers.
